method: Every question from every paper in this archive is matched to one syllabus topic by keyword rules that were checked by hand. Importance = total marks the topic has carried across all papers (High = top third). Backward-looking only - not a prediction.
summary: 17 papers (2013 to Aug 2025), 271 questions. By total marks the heaviest topics are: Execution: modes, arrest and detention, attachment and sale, garnishee; Jurisdiction and place of suing; Parties: joinder, non-joinder, misjoinder; Limitation: concept, S.3 bar and general principles. Most repeated in the papers from 2022 onwards: Execution: modes, arrest and detention, attachment and sale, garnishee (9×); Written statement, set-off and counter-claim (9×); Jurisdiction and place of suing (7×); Parties: joinder, non-joinder, misjoinder (7×). This shows what has been asked before; it is not a prediction.
